name: Gasthof Acherkogel
beschreibung: The Gasthof Acherkogel is located in the Tyrol region of Austria. The property operates as a hotel and offers a warm, traditional atmosphere. The surrounding area is shaped by a dramatic mountain landscape. Guests can look forward to comfortable amenities, including an on-site restaurant and cosy guest rooms. Its location is ideal for hiking, outdoor pursuits, and winter sports. The hotel is clean and functional, serving as a dependable base for exploring the region.
